Getting Started

Welcome to the Deep Research Engine. This section will help you get up and running.

Quick Navigation

  • arrow_forwardInstallation - Install the package and dependencies
  • arrow_forwardQuick Start - Run your first workflow in minutes

What is Deep Research Engine?

Deep Research Engine is a high-performance orchestration framework for:

  • arrow_forwardMulti-agent intelligence - Coordinate multiple AI agents for complex research tasks
  • arrow_forwardVector search - Semantic memory and knowledge retrieval
  • arrow_forwardRecursive knowledge synthesis - Iterative refinement and quality assurance
  • arrow_forwardMultimodal processing - Handle text, PDFs, audio, video, and images

Architecture Overview

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
Config (YAML) → Engine → Ingestion → Drafter ↔ Critic → Neo4j → Synthesis

The engine uses a 5-node pipeline:

  1. arrow_forwardIngestion - Extract text from various sources (PDFs, audio, video, web)
  2. arrow_forwardDrafter - Plan and execute research tasks with sub-agents
  3. arrow_forwardCritic - Quality assurance and revision loop
  4. arrow_forwardNeo4j Builder - Optional knowledge graph construction
  5. arrow_forwardSynthesis - Generate final reports and outputs

Prerequisites

  • arrow_forwardPython 3.11+
  • arrow_forwardDocker (for infrastructure services)
  • arrow_forwardAccess to LLM providers (via LiteLLM)
